-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #1000 / Scene #1 - Function talkevent1_1
function talkevent1_1()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town000D.map")
	MoveCamera(231.00, 142.00, 96.34)
	RotCamera(4.71, 1.47, 12.00)

	CreateObject(0, 1478, 231.00, 144.00, 212, 0, FALSE, 1, 1)
	CreateObject(1, 1480, 238.00, 137.00, 170, 0, FALSE, 1, 19)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayMusic("BGM031.ogg")
	PlayCameraNoWait("tutorial_01_1.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(500)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 1)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 2)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(talkevent1_1)
